subject.title: fix(message): ignore populated location on text sends

question: Should OpenClaw make `normalizeMessageActionRequest` a supported public Channel Plugin SDK contract for owner-specific pre-dispatch normalization, or require a narrower Telegram/core seam for this repair?
rationale: The hook changes the exported channel adapter contract and API baseline, so implementation correctness alone cannot determine whether external plugins should receive this action-rewriting capability.

options.title: Approve the narrow public hook
options.body: Keep the hook, document its ordering and origin guarantees, and retain the focused compatibility tests for external channel implementations.

options.title: Use a narrower Telegram/core seam
options.body: Rework the repair so Telegram-specific model-origin normalization does not add a general public channel SDK contract.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow public hook
recommendation.body: Keep the hook, document its ordering and origin guarantees, and retain the focused compatibility tests for external channel implementations.
